tasks.label: Show running PrimeOps client and owner
tasks.command: curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --output /dev/null --write-out 'PrimeOps client: http://localhost:3000/ - HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/ && curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --output /dev/null --write-out 'PrimeOps owner: http://localhost:3001/admin/ - HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3001/admin/

tasks.label: PrimeOps client and owner - persistent server logs
tasks.command:
printf '
PrimeOps client: http://localhost:3000/
PrimeOps owner: http://localhost:3001/admin/
Services use Docker restart policy unless-stopped. Keep forwarded ports private.

' && docker logs --follow --tail 10 feenstra-light-surveys-app-1
